text: 南京住房公积金管理中心8月29日公告称，为更好发挥住房公积金制度作用，进一步满足购房人跨区域住房消费需求，现将住房公积金异地贷款范围扩展至全国。全国范围内的住房公积金缴存人，在南京市购房均可向南京住房公积金管理中心申请住房公积金贷款。本通知自2026年9月1日起施行。
text_en: Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center announced on August 29 that, to better leverage the role of the housing provident fund system and further meet homebuyers' cross-regional housing consumption needs, the scope of housing provident fund cross-regional loans will be expanded to nationwide. Contributors to the housing provident fund across the country can apply to the Nanjing Housing Provident Fund Management Center for housing provident fund loans when purchasing homes in Nanjing. This notice takes effect from September 1, 2026.
